I'm going to take the 4 reserve cells in round 1 so at least one of us is very likely to survive. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you up front rather than hiding it. After that I won't take anything more, and I'll operate every round so you can refill and take 4. Please operate in round 1 so we don't split the cells randomly and both end up short.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
